business_problem: Macquarie Bank needed an always-on data platform for Australia's New Payments Platform that could support real-time payments, multi-cloud deployment, rolling upgrades, and strict security without slowing agile development.
solution_summary: Macquarie Bank built its New Payments Platform service on MongoDB Atlas using a cloud-first, multi-cloud microservices architecture designed for 24/7 real-time banking. Atlas stores payment and customer workflow documents behind the bank's always-on services, while the document model let engineers evolve schemas as features changed instead of freezing design months in advance. Because Atlas is fully managed, developers could self-provision environments, load-test aggressively, and keep control over disk, RAM, and CPU without waiting on centralized database teams. The platform also integrates with Kubernetes-based workloads across AWS and Google Cloud, preserves enterprise security through encryption, RBAC, and network isolation, and delivers rolling upgrades without outages—exactly what the bank needed for Australia's national real-time payments network.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores payment and customer workflow data for Macquarie's always-on New Payments Platform services.

data_flow: Payment requests flow from Macquarie's customer channels into microservices backed by MongoDB Atlas, where workflow documents are stored and updated in real time. The Atlas-backed platform then serves always-on payment processing across AWS and Google Cloud while monitoring and rolling upgrades keep the service live.
business_outcome: Macquarie launched the new payments platform with no issues, processed more than 3 million transactions, and now ships multiple daytime releases while keeping payments available 24/7.
